newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH MARCH WOOD PURCHASES DOWN 58 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH MARCH WOOD PURCHASES DOWN 58 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: The Finnish forest industry's raw wood purchases fell 58 pct year-on-year in March to 1.6 million cubic metres, the Finnish Forest Research Insitute (METLA) said in a statement on Friday.
Purchases were 0.6 million cubic metres down from February and the market was more quiet in March than on average in the same month during the past five years, METLA said.

Trade had been thin because the market waited for raw wood price agreements, it said, adding trade had picked up since agreements on prices were reached in March. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
